review_evidence: The authoritative unit contains 1,124 primary Lean files spanning FormalRV arithmetic, Shor/QPE/QFT, QEC, Pauli-product measurement, lattice-surgery, scheduling/resource frameworks, per-paper audits, code generation, and checked end-to-end examples.

The repository README documents machine-checked correctness/resource theorems throughout those subtrees and identifies examples and audit modules as executable or theorem-bearing verification artifacts, not prose-only scaffolding.

The primary Lean material is mathematically and verification relevant across the unit; no source-local exact-path or subtree invariant was established that could exclude any primary file without risking unique definitions, statements, proofs, interfaces, examples, or navigation evidence.
